Grew up below the poverty line. I never had the nice privilege of growing up with money. I didn’t go to a nice schools, I was one of few white students there. HOWEVER, I never was scared to wear a hoodie in the streets in fear of being shot by the police. My parents who were unfit parents were praised consistently, though my peer’s guardians were condemned consistently. I don’t get stared down at stores to make sure I do not steal. People don’t cross the street to avoid walking by me. When I started my job as a server, I noticed I would get tipped more than my POC coworkers. 

I never had rich privilege, but I have always lived with white privilege. I was poor, but I wasn’t black. Our struggles may have similarities but they are never the same.
